description: The CP_OdU research team deposits climate projections for Odesa, Ukraine, for 2021–2050. The dataset extracts daily values from Euro-CORDEX regional climate models at the land grid point closest to the Odesa meteorological site. The article counts 14 models and 102 simulations under RCP4.5 and RCP8.5 and derives monthly or annual climate indices for heat, drought, rainfall, snow and wind. Zenodo lists compressed archives for the daily outputs and individual indices, with an explanatory readme. Its licence is CC-BY-4.0 and public access is free. Spatial resolution is the source 0.11-degree regional grid, about 12 kilometres, but the deposited series represent one selected cell, not a city-wide raster. Model spread and the land-cell position limit neighbourhood-scale interpretation. The data can inform coastal-city heat, drainage, transport and electricity-demand simulations under future climate conditions. They complement data-cmip6-climate-projections-cds with an Odesa-specific extraction; no scenario file was downloaded.
